title: Relationship Depth Assessment: an honest partnership profile
subtitle: Measure communication, resilience, personal space, and shared growth — quick or full depth.
seoTitle: Relationship Depth Quiz | Resilience & Communication Scores | DailyLogic
seoDescription: An honest relationship questionnaire: quick check or 30 deep questions. Get resilience, communication, space, and growth scores — free in your browser.
heroDescription: Real partnership includes routine, compromise, and repair after conflict. This assessment builds an honest profile with clear metrics and common-sense tips — thoughtful, not cynical.

sections.heading: What the Relationship Depth Assessment does
paragraphs: Instead of a light compatibility quiz, this tool asks about everyday dynamics: how you talk when it’s hard, how you repair after fights, how you protect personal space, and how you grow together under pressure.
Choose a quick check of about 10 questions for a fast snapshot, or a full 30-question depth assessment for a richer analysis. Answers are weighted into clear dimension scores.
Everything runs locally in your browser — save results, share a result card, and reopen the full report from recent calculations.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Pick a mode, answer on a frequency scale (almost never to almost always), and follow the progress bar. You’ll get a profile, four metrics, insights, and practical tips.
Save the result to reopen it from the home page with expand for the full report, or download a shareable card.
The assessment is for gentle honesty — not judgment. Use it as a conversation starter, not a verdict.

sections.heading: Why honest relationship metrics matter
paragraphs: Long-term partnership leans on repair, not perfection. Metrics like resilience and communication help you see strengths and soft spots.
Tips focus on common sense: repair rituals, fair load, personal space, and short regular talks.
Retaking the assessment later can show change — without turning love into scorekeeping.

faq.question: Do we need to answer together?
faq.answer: Solo or together both work. If together, stay honest even when you disagree on items.

faq.question: Is data sent to a server?
faq.answer: No. Answers and saves stay in your browser.

faq.question: What’s the difference between quick and full?
faq.answer: Quick gives a fast overview; full covers more situations and sharpens the metrics.
